# 🛠 Contributing Guide — B4OS Landing Page 2025

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the **B4OS Landing Page 2025** project!  
This website serves as the official landing page for the **Bitcoin for Open Source (B4OS)** program — a free technical training initiative for senior developers interested in the Bitcoin open-source ecosystem across Latin America and the Caribbean.

---

## 🎯 Project Goals

The landing page is designed to:

- Present the goals and structure of the B4OS program.
- Help recruit talented developers through clear onboarding paths.
- Serve as the central hub for registration, event timelines, and official updates.
- Share promotional content and social media links.
- Highlight the benefits of participating in the program.

---

## ⚙️ Development Setup

This project uses standard web technologies: **HTML5**, **CSS3**, and **JavaScript**.

### Requirements

- Modern web browser  
- Code editor (we recommend Visual Studio Code)  
- [Live Server](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ritwickdey.LiveServer) extension (optional)

### Getting Started

1. Clone the repository:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/your-username/B40S-Landing-Page-2025.git
   cd B40S-Landing-Page-2025
````

2. Open the `index.html` file in your browser or run Live Server.

3. Make your changes and test the site on both desktop and mobile viewports.

---

## 🧑‍💻 Code Style Guidelines

* Use 2-space indentation.
* Use lowercase and hyphens for file/folder names (`kebab-case`).
* Ensure the layout remains responsive (mobile-friendly).
* Comment your code when making significant changes.
* Keep styles organized by section or component when possible.

---

## 🐞 Reporting Issues or Requesting Features

Use the [Issues](https://github.com/your-username/B40S-Landing-Page-2025/issues) section to:

* Report bugs
* Suggest new sections or improvements
* Ask questions about the project

Please include screenshots or detailed descriptions when relevant.

---

## 📥 Submitting a Pull Request

1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a new branch:

   ```bash
   git checkout -b improve-registration-button
   ```
3. Make your changes and commit them:

   ```bash
   git commit -m "Fix mobile layout for registration button"
   ```
4. Push your branch and open a Pull Request to `main`.

The team will review your submission and may provide feedback before merging.

---

## 💬 Communication Channels

Have questions or ideas? Reach out to the team via:

* Twitter/X: [@B4OSdev](https://twitter.com/B4OSdev)
* Email: [contacto@b4os.org](mailto:contacto@b4os.org) *(replace with your actual email if available)*
* Telegram: [Official Channel](https://t.me/b4os_dev)

---

## ✅ Review Process

* All PRs must be reviewed by at least one maintainer.
* We check for functionality, clarity, and visual consistency.
* Include clear commit messages and PR descriptions.
